Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Security hardening: Phase 2 implementation

This commit implements critical security improvements for production readiness:

## Security Enhancements:

### 1. Rate Limiting (NEW)
- Installed @upstash/ratelimit and @upstash/redis
- Created lib/rate-limit.ts with graceful degradation
- Auth endpoints: 5 requests per 15 minutes per IP
- Document generation: 10 requests per hour per user
- API endpoints: 100 requests per minute per IP
- Works without Redis (development) and with Redis (production)
- Applied to middleware and document generation

### 2. Password Strength Requirements (NEW)
- Created passwordSchema with strict validation
- Requires: 8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special char
- Applied to sign-up and password update actions
- Prevents weak passwords

### 3. LLM Input Sanitization (NEW)
- Created lib/llm-sanitize.ts
- Prevents prompt injection attacks
- Removes dangerous patterns (system prompts, jailbreak attempts)
- Validates against token exhaustion attacks
- Sanitizes all user inputs before LLM processing
- Applied to document generation workflow

### 4. CSRF Protection (NEW)
- Added origin verification for all POST requests
- Security headers: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.
- Referrer-Policy and X-XSS-Protection
- Leverages Next.js Server Actions built-in CSRF protection

### 5. Authorization Fixes (IMPROVED)
- Fixed removeTeamMember to require owner role
- Added team membership verification
- Prevents self-removal
- Prevents cross-team manipulation

## Documentation:

- Updated DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md with Phase 2 completion status
- Updated SECURITY.md with implemented security features
- All security improvements documented

## Files Changed:

- app/(login)/actions.ts: Password strength + auth fixes
- app/(dashboard)/dashboard/documents/actions.ts: Rate limiting + sanitization
- middleware.ts: Rate limiting + CSRF + security headers
- lib/rate-limit.ts: NEW - Rate limiting utilities
- lib/llm-sanitize.ts: NEW - Input sanitization for LLM
- DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md: Phase 2 completion documentation
- SECURITY.md: Updated with implemented features
- package.json: Added @upstash dependencies

EOF
